_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Fifty-fifth scheduled run. NO NEW FINDINGS: zero matches without an existing case across 10,304 product pages on 15 serving URLs. A SECOND SITE WENT UNREACHABLE TODAY, and it is a different failure from the one we know. Flower Meadow Dream (www.myroseworld.com) returned HTTP 502 Bad Gateway at the egress proxy's CONNECT stage on the scheduled pass and again on a re-pull. That is NOT the proxy refusing the host -- a refusal is a 403 -- and kisakiplant.com and highgardenroses.com both returned HTTP 200 through the same proxy minutes later, so the proxy itself was healthy. A 502 means the connection was attempted and the upstream did not answer properly, which points at the site's own origin rather than our network policy. Rose Watch cannot distinguish a site being down from a failure somewhere between us and it, and the record says so rather than guessing. The site had served on every run since 2026-10-20; this is its first failure. 8 cases unchecked, Last Verified held, each carrying a dated note. Per the standing precedent the crawler keeps making the same request each run and nothing is worked around. Xavian's Roses was refused for a seventh consecutive run (9 cases unchecked). 22 cases went unchecked in total, against 14 on a normal day. Your Roses grew 1,764 -> 1,769 products with no new matches among them.
